input.rationale: Section 9 is limited to mutual corporate-existence/authority representations (p0056-p0057) and a Globix acknowledgement (p0058); nothing anywhere in the Agreement warrants HDI's development, hosting or Site software, and there is no stated duration or remedy (no \"AS IS\" disclaimer exists either). Article 1 imposes only delivery and operation obligations. With no express performance warranty at all, the rule's fallback is not met, so we insert the shortest fallback-level warranty: 90-day conformance of the Site software to its documentation, a 30-day Services warranty, and repair, replacement or refund as remedies. We did not pursue the preferred 12-month/compliance-with-laws/no-malicious-code package.

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.

proposal.summary: Insert an express performance warranty with remedies as Section 9(c)
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 contains only corporate-authority warranties, so we added a short performance warranty at our fallback position: 90-day conformance of the Site software to its documentation, a 30-day Services warranty, and repair, replacement or refund as the remedy.

ops.text: HDI warrants that (1) for ninety (90) days following the Effective Date, the Site and any software provided by HDI hereunder will conform in all material respects to their documentation, and (2) for thirty (30) days following performance, the Services will conform in all material respects to the requirements of this Agreement. The Company's remedy for breach of this warranty is repair or replacement of the non-conforming software or Services, or a refund of the fees paid for them.
